summary: Create or overwrite a file (preview-first). The sanctioned, audited way to write into the work target.

path.description: file path (relative to the work target, or absolute within the roots)

content.description: the full file contents to write

overwrite.description: false = create-only; refuse if the file exists

unique.description: if the path is taken, CREATE a timestamp-suffixed sibling instead of refusing; the preview names the resolved path and apply_with carries it
